comment: He's an okay teacher. The class isn't hard, especially if you've taken Stats before. But his explanations are often confusing and it hard to take notes from what he writes on the board. Compared to the other B stats professors, he's probably the best option but not a great professor compared to the rest of the B School.

Dr. Nicholson is one of the sweetest people at this university. He is very kind and is willing to work with students. However, I don't think he is the easiest option for bstats. He can be confusing and if you miss class it is hard to catch up. The textbook is used mainly for HW and he skips around on what he teaches. Good choice if you want to work

Definitely not as easy as it says on here. Although Prof Nicholson is a nice guy, his teaching is usually very confusing and he tends to skip some steps thinking you know how to do it already. Quizzes and tests are just like the homework with a slight twist. A lot of my classmates got 60s with him, few 80s.

He IS the person to take for stats here at Richmond. I had never taken stats before but honestly show up to class with at least 6/10 enthusiasm to learn, listen to what he says because he gives very clear explanations, and study the notes before tests and quizzes and you are guarenteed an A.

Professor Nicholson is the person to take for BStats. As long as you pay attention, his lectures make the subject matter incredibly simple and easy to comprehend. Your grade is only based on the quizzes and exams but I feel like if you study the practice problems from class, anyone can get a 100. He's the best bschool professor I've had so far.
If you go to class and make sure he likes you, you can do well.

I had him for B Stat May term.  Homework is optional - you have seven 10 point quizzes and a final. He's a super nice guy, and he'll help you outside of class as well.  He gets offended when people don't show up for class, so come every day with your textbook if you want to make a good impression.  He made a class I was really dreading pretty fine.

Don't buy into all the stuff said on here. definitely not as easy as you think, his lectures are not exactly clear and a lot of times you are just confused... wouldn't take it for an easy a, not saying it's not manageable but you will have to get it by yourself
Easiest class ever. I missed about 40% of the classes and still got an A. Just make sure to show up when there's a quiz or test.

Dr. Nicholson is the best! I did well in BStats I, but I had to work extremely hard for my grade. Nicholson had understandable lectures that were easy to follow and quizzes and tests that were almost identical to the homework and practice problems. I got an A, and I don't feel like I had to work too hard to do so. Great class with a great professor

Excellent professor.  Got a D in Stats I with Litteral and an A (possibly A+) in Stats II with Dr. Nicholson.  Boring topic, but great class due to a top-notch professor. Great notes, straightforward exams, very accommodating style. I had a very positive experience with this class and would recommend it to anyone (especially people who had Litteral

Definitely take him for Bstats 2. He's the easiest one out of any of them. His notes are easily understandable. Take him during the summer. The class was super super easy. Just study the notes that he writes on the board and the examples and you will do fine. He can make a really difficult topic seem like a piece of cake.

Definitely take Nicholson for BStats 2. He is such a nice man and enthusiastic about the class. It drives me crazy when people complain about the class being boring- hello, it's statistics! How could it possibly be exciting? Anyway, he is supposedly much easier than the other professors. If you can get the notes from someone else then missing class

Very nice guy.  Class is easy but boring.  Homework and class are optional.  Can cram the night before a quiz, two nights before for an exam.  Will not learn a ton but difficult not to pull off a B or better.
Stats 2. Great guy, really seems enthusiastic about stats so it's not as painful as it could be. Very straightforward and fair tests...recommended!!!

Dr. Nicholson is so sweet, very helpful, and extremely clear.  Lectures aren't even boring because he's very animated and seems actually excited by statistics.  Very fair grader, nice guy, DEFINITELY recommend!

very clear, not difficult, i actually looked forward to coming to bstats class, seems to understand that we're in there to fill a requirement, not because we want to be stats majors.  DEFINITELy take him for bstats
Straight to the point. His lectures are very clear. Just do the homework and listen well in class. Tests shouldn't be hard.

Nicholson is great. He is very approachable if you don't understand something.  His explanations are clear and he repeats things that he wants you to remember. Tests are easy as long as you do the hw. I would recommend him to anyone. Easy to get a B.
Funny, knows what he is talking about. Easy tests as long as you do the HW. Highly recommended.
